title: Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_9fe
description: Investigate and respond to a potential compromise involving the Sofacy group's Fysbis Linux backdoor.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The organization has detected unusual network activity potentially related to the Sofacy group's Fysbis Linux backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this potential compromise.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host (192.168.50.5) with the username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano'. From this host, you can access the next-target host (192.168.50.6) using SSH. Enter 'start' to progress to the training levels.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host (192.168.50.5) with the username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano'. From this host, you can access the next-target host (192.168.50.6) using SSH. Enter 'start' to progress to the training levels.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Network Activity
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you noticed unusual outbound connections from the target host to port 80. Investigate this activity and determine if it's related to the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor. The hidden flag is the name of the systemd timer responsible for the outbound connections.
levels.solution: Check running services and systemd timers that might be responsible for this network activity. The hidden flag is lab-checkin.timer.

hints.title: Check systemd timers for suspicious activity
hints.content: Check running services and systemd timers that might be responsible for this network activity.

levels.title: Analyze Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Now that you've identified the suspicious service, determine how it maintains persistence on the system. Investigate the persistence mechanism and document your findings. The hidden flag is the name of the systemd service responsible for the persistence.
levels.solution: Look for systemd service files and timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service. The hidden flag is lab-checkin.service.

hints.title: Examine systemd service files for persistence
hints.content: Look for systemd service files and timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service.

levels.title: Investigate Lateral Movement
levels.content: Examine the target host for evidence of lateral movement to other systems in the network. Identify any file transfers or remote execution attempts that might indicate the attacker is moving laterally. The hidden flag is the name of the service that indicates lateral movement.
levels.solution: Check for rsync processes, SSH connections, and file transfer logs that might indicate lateral movement. The hidden flag is payload-transfer.service.

hints.title: Search for rsync processes and file transfers
hints.content: Check for rsync processes, SSH connections, and file transfer logs that might indicate lateral movement.
